verses.1: And He created the whole world out of nothing, and He prepared it and set it in order; He established the mountains and laid the foundations and made the earth firm upon the waters, so that it should not be shaken forever. For first of all God said, "Let there be light."
verses.2: And there was light while the world was still in darkness; and God made a work, and He prepared it and made the world firm with what is fitting and what is proper. And He said, "Let there be evening and darkness."
verses.3: And again God said, "Let there be light," and there was morning, and there was light; and He raised the lower waters above the heavens.
verses.4: And He spread it out like a vault, and with the wind He supported it; and the lower waters He gathered beneath the depths of the sea.
verses.5: And He dried up the gathering places of the sea by His command, and He made them firm by His spirit, so that they should not overflow beneath the depths; and He gathered together the wild beasts and the cattle within it, and the great creatures within it, which have no number, both those that are seen and those that are not seen.
verses.6: And on the third day God made plants upon the dry land, and every herb and tree according to its kind, and fruit trees that bear fruit.
verses.7: And the plant of life, beautiful to look upon and pleasant to eat, and the herb and every green thing of the earth whose seed is within it. And He appointed food for all the cattle and the wild beasts and the birds, and He gave sustenance to everything that He had created.
verses.8: And there was evening and there was morning. And on the fourth day God said, "Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven." And God made the sun and the moon and the stars, and He set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth and to rule over the day and the night.
verses.9: And from that time the sun and the moon and the stars were appointed over the day and the night.
verses.10: And on the fifth day God created all the wild beasts and the cattle that dwell in the heavens, and all the birds that fly above the air, and everything that is seen and that is not seen; all these God created.
verses.11: And on the sixth day He created all the wild beasts and the cattle and the creeping things, and every creature; and last of all He created Adam in His image and in His likeness.
verses.12: And He subjected to him all the wild beasts and the cattle that He had created, so that he might reign over them, and also all the cattle and the wild beasts and the fish and the creatures that dwell in the sea.
verses.13: And also the sheep and all the herds upon the earth, and the creatures that are seen and those that are not seen.
verses.14: And He appointed the son of the living one, whom He had made in His image and in His likeness, and He commanded him to eat and to till the garden and to praise God therein.
verses.15: And that he should not transgress the commandment of God, and that he should not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, the tree of death.
verses.16: For He said, "On the day that you eat of this tree, you shall surely die."
verses.17: And through the deceit of the serpent, Eve was led astray, and she ate of that tree and gave it to our father Adam.
verses.18: And he ate of that tree, and he brought death upon himself and upon his children.
verses.19: And God was angry with our father Adam, because he had transgressed His commandment and had eaten of that tree of which God had commanded him not to eat; and He drove him out of the garden, and He gave him this earth of thorns and thistles, which was cursed because of him when he transgressed His commandment, that he should till it and eat the herb of his labor by the sweat of his face.
verses.20: And when God brought him out into this earth, Adam returned in sorrow and anguish of heart, and he began to till the ground and to eat by the sweat of his face, in toil and in labor.
